10.01.2026 WPSS No.126 of 2026
Hon’ble Subhash Upadhyay, J.
Mr. Sanjay Bhatt, learned counsel for the 
petitioner. 
2. Mr. Ganesh Kandpal, learned Deputy 
A.G. for the State.
3. Learned counsel for the petitioner 
submits that petitioner has been declared 
ineligible from participating in the counselling 
to be held for the post of Assistant Teacher in 
Elementary Schools, on the ground that 
petitioner has crossed the prescribed upper 
age limit.
4. Learned counsel would press for interim 
relief and would submit that the counselling is 
scheduled to be held on 12.01.2026.
5. Counter affidavit, if any, to be filed in 
four weeks.
6. List on 16.02.2026.
7. As an interim measure, it is provided that 
the petitioner shall be permitted to participate 
in the counselling for the post of Assistant 
Teacher in Elementary Schools, provisionally. 
However, the result of the selection, so far it 
relates to the petitioner, shall not be declared, 
without express leave of the Court.  8. Let certified copy of this order be 
supplied to learned counsel for the parties, 
today itself, on payment of usual charges.
 (Subhash Upadhyay, J.) 
 10.01.2026
Rajni
